mentions.name: RespCode
mentions.description: This AI coding assistant orchestrates multiple LLMs (Claude, GPT-4o, DeepSeek, Gemini) through three modes: Compete (runs a prompt across models side-by-side so the user picks the winner), Collaborate (chains models in a refinement pipeline), and Consensus (independent generation merged into one solution). Generated code executes instantly in real sandboxes supporting x86_64, ARM64, RISC-V, and ARM32, showing compilation output, runtime results, and exit codes.
mentions.problem: Single-model AI coding assistants give one answer that can be wrong or hallucinated, which is risky when building production systems.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built RespCode because I was frustrated with the "one model, one answer" approach to AI coding assistants. When you're building production systems, blindly trusting a single AI's output is risky. What if it hallucinated? What if there's a better approach?
